entries.notes: NVIDIA RTX, compute capability 7.5 or newer. LocDiT runs on a locally built TensorRT engine; W8A16 storage holds the 6 GiB budget.
Same model revision and same pins as the Windows profile, so a sentence synthesized on either system comes from one graph.
AMD gfx1013 class hardware that no supported ROCm build reaches. Synthesis runs in a child VoxCPM.cpp server over Vulkan; this runtime still owns text preparation and audio finishing.
Reserved for AMD RX hardware a ROCm torch build supports. ROCm presents itself as a torch cuda device, so the torch backend serves it without a separate code path.
Reserved for a Windows Vulkan runtime. Windows voice executable and a verified Windows synthesis path are not implemented yet.
